   MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  NORWALK COMMUNITY PROMOTION COMMISSION
  October 13, 2025

Vice Chair Ang called the meeting to order at 6:10 p.m. Responding to roll call were Vice Chair Ang,
Commissioner Sanchez, and Commissioner Garcia. Chair Leon and Commissioner Lopez were absent.
Also present was Levy Sun, Director of Communications, Alex Ocegueda, Office Assistant III, Jocelyn
Hernandez, Communications Specialist, Michael Roseoff, Public Safety Commissioner and Patricia
Hoskins, Public Safety Commissioner.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Commissioner Sanchez made the motion and Commissioner Garcia seconded to approve the minutes
for September 8, 2025. There being no objection, the motion carried.

REPORTS

First Responders Luncheon

Mrs. Ocegueda presented Commissioners with food options from Mr. Rosewood’s, Ho Ho China, and
Angie’s. After discussion, Commission decided on choosing Mr. Rosewood’s to cater for the event.
Mrs. Ocegueda informed Commissioners of the change to décor/centerpieces due to the additional
guests and tables needed; Commissioner Sanchez requested that American Flags be used for the
centerpieces along with the rest of the décor. Mr. Sun explained the reason for the additional guests
and the change to the run of the show that will include a video. Mrs. Ocegueda asked Commissioners
to be at the Sports Complex no later than 10:30am to receive their assignments. Mrs. Ocegueda asked
Commissioners if they wished to provide the postcards and pens at the tables for First Responders to
write a thank-you to the students; Commission confirmed that they wish to provide the postcards.

Native Plant Landscaping Contest

Mr. Sun presented recommendations for a Native Plant Landscape Contest for Commissioners to
consider due to the low participation in the Home and Business Beautification Contest due to increase
in construction costs and some vocal residents requesting that the City encourage other residents to
use native landscaping. Commissioner Garcia asked how this contest would be promoted to the
community. Mr. Sun explained that it would be promoted thru Norwalk Now and social media platforms;
and it’s possible that the contest would also receive promotion and judging assistance from Cerritos
College Native Plant Sanctuary and the Greater Los Angeles County Vector Control Agency if the
Commission decides to proceed with the contest. Commissioner Garcia suggested having a
Commission booth at city events similar to the merchandise booths they had to peak people’s interest
in the contest and provide native plant vendor information.

   Public Comments: Daniel Moreno and Anna Valcarcel are both in favor of the Native Plant
  Landscape contest
 Minutes of the Regular Meeting
Community Promotion Commission
October 13, 2025

After further discussion and hearing public comments, Vice Chair Ang asked Mrs. Ocegueda to proceed
with a roll call vote to decide if the Commission will adopt the Native Landscaping contest:

   Vice Chair Ang: In favor
   Commissioner Garcia: In favor
   Commissioner Sanchez: In favor

There being no objection, the motion carried. The Community Promotion Commission will adopt
and proceed with developing the Native Landscaping contest.

Business Spotlight

Ms. Hernandez showed the “Keeping It Norwalk” Campaign, the September Bakery Spots edition video
to Commissioners. Mrs. Ocegueda stated that she will be working with the multi-media team to finalize
the theme list for 2026 and should have it ready at the next meeting for the Commission’s review and
approval.

Merchandise Surveys

Mrs. Ocegueda asked Commissioners if they had any updates regarding their research of print
shops/businesses and pricing of merchandise. Vice Chair Ang stated he reached out to the individual
regarding pricing but has still not heard back and would reach out again. Commissioners asked if Mrs.
Ocegueda can provide print outs of the designs residents voted on to discuss at the next meeting.

Communications and Public Affairs Analytics

Ms. Hernandez provided the analytics and explained Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and the city’s
overall reach across all outreach platforms for the last month showing an increase in key metrics.

STAFF COMMENTS:

Mrs. Ocegueda confirmed with Commissioners that they would be attending the Historical Heritage
Commission meeting date on October 27, 2025 at 4:30 pm at the Norwalk Arts and Sports Complex to
make their possible collaboration presentation. Commissioner Sanchez stated he will be unable to
attend. Vice Chair Ang asked if they would be on their meeting agenda. Mrs. Ocegueda confirmed
they would on the agenda and she will have a power point presentation ready for them that explains
what the Community Promotion Commission stands for.

COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS:

Vice Chair Ang provided Chair Leon’s feedback about her experience at the Arturo Sanchez Sr.
Halloween Parade and confirmed her attendance for the First Responders Appreciation Luncheon.
Vice Chair Ang stated he attended the Mary Paxton Art Gallery for the Halloween parade’s display
opening. Vice Chair Ang enjoyed seeing Commissioner Sanchez and his family there to provide more

insight on the displayed items and thought the entire event was well put together to honor their legacy.
Vice Chair Ang also commented on his first experience as a parade participant and how his invited
family and friends were phenomenally impressed with the event. Commissioner Sanchez wanted to
thank his fellow commissioners, volunteers, and city staff for all their hard work and dedication to the
legacy his dad started and left behind for the Sanchez Family to continue in partnership with the City
of Norwalk.

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:39 p.m.

_____________________________

David Ang, Vice Chair
Community Promotion Commission
